gaps.sentence: If you pressed that red button, what ___?
gaps.hint: hypothetical result of an unreal action
gaps.explanation: The result of an unreal present condition takes 'would': would happen.

gaps.sentence: Unless it ___ below five degrees tonight, the event will go ahead.
gaps.explanation: 'Unless' clauses take the present simple even when referring to tonight: drops.

gaps.sentence: If only I ___ more at university!
gaps.explanation: 'If only + past perfect' — regret about a past failure.

gaps.sentence: I would never have found the house if you ___ me the postcode.
gaps.explanation: The unreal past condition takes the past perfect: had not sent.

gaps.sentence: I will note the reference number in case I ___ it later.
gaps.hint: in case means as a precaution
gaps.explanation: 'In case' describes a precaution and takes the present simple: need.

gaps.sentence: If the pain ___, stop taking the tablets and call your doctor.
gaps.hint: medical instruction with present after if
gaps.explanation: Conditional instructions use the present simple in the if-clause: gets worse.

gaps.sentence: Unless something urgent ___, I will be at my desk all morning.
gaps.hint: unless introduces the exception, present simple
gaps.explanation: 'Unless' introduces the exception to the plan and takes the present simple: comes up.

gaps.sentence: If he had not left his passport at home, he ___ the earlier flight.
gaps.hint: third conditional result, would have participle
gaps.explanation: The unreal past result takes 'would have' plus the participle: would have caught.
